capstmts.title: RTPBC Requester Capability Statement
capstmts.security: Implementers are expected to follow core FHIR security principles (https://www.hl7.org/fhir/security.html).In addition, the FHIR Security and Privacy Module (http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/secpriv-module.html) describes how to protect patient privacy.

capstmts.title: RTPBC Responder Capability Statement
capstmts.security: Implementers are expected to follow core FHIR security principles (https://www.hl7.org/fhir/security.html).In addition, the FHIR Security and Privacy Module (http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/secpriv-module.html) describes how to protect patient privacy. A server **SHALL** reject any unauthorized requests by returning an `HTTP 401` unauthorized response code.
